findings.highlight: He said he doesn’t mind having you over at my place since I’m a teacher
findings.evidenceJa: 先生の家なら安心だ、ご指導よろしくお願いします
findings.governingReading: a teacher’s house is safe, and he asks me to look after and instruct you
findings.explanation: Zouken’s stated confidence and formal request are reduced to mere permission based on Taiga’s profession.

findings.highlight: do you want to use the same underwear too
findings.evidenceJa: 下着もわたしのでいいかな
findings.governingReading: will my underwear work for you too
findings.explanation: Taiga offers underwear she owns; “the same underwear” can imply sharing the identical garment.

findings.highlight: But isn’t it uncomfortable?
findings.evidenceJa: 素朴な疑問を投げてみる
findings.governingReading: I pose that innocent question
findings.explanation: Taiga’s self-narrating comic delivery is omitted.

findings.highlight: I’ll get the guys at my place to buy some for you
findings.evidenceJa: うちの若いのに揃えさせておく
findings.governingReading: I will have the young one in our house obtain it for you
findings.explanation: Taiga’s singular euphemistic reference to Shirou becomes multiple unspecified men.

findings.highlight: don’t worry, just go ahead and take your bath
findings.evidenceJa: 遠慮なくお風呂はいってらっしゃい
findings.governingReading: go take your bath without hesitation
findings.explanation: Sakura’s freedom from social reserve is replaced by reassurance about worry.

findings.highlight: I won’t even be able to look at Sakura without thinking
findings.evidenceJa: 意識してないのに意識しちまって、桜をまともに見られなくなる
findings.governingReading: it will make me conscious of it despite not having been conscious, and unable to look Sakura in the face
findings.explanation: The involuntary shift into sexual awareness and its effect on direct eye contact are blurred.

findings.highlight: sexy
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体は柔らかそう
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body looks soft
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces imagined softness with an explicit judgment of sexual attractiveness.

findings.highlight: want to touch her
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きしめたい
findings.governingReading: want to embrace her
findings.explanation: A desire for an embrace is generalized to sexualized touching.

findings.highlight: Why are you telling him like that
findings.evidenceJa: どうしてそうゆうコトするんですか
findings.governingReading: why would you do something like that?
findings.explanation: Sakura objects to Taiga’s entire conduct, not only telling Shirou.

findings.highlight: You idiot, Fuji-nee
findings.evidenceJa: ばか言ってんじゃないぞ、藤ねえー、とか
findings.governingReading: inactive semicolon-commented Shirou rebuke
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s classic unvoiced branch restores a commented-out Shirou line and its quiet continuation.

findings.highlight: she is trying to cover Fuji-nee’s mouth
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に藤ねえの口を押さえている
findings.governingReading: she is desperately holding Fuji-nee’s mouth shut
findings.explanation: Sakura’s desperate force and continuing success are weakened to an attempt.

findings.highlight: I didn’t know you were that strong
findings.evidenceJa: 見かけによらず武闘派
findings.governingReading: you are unexpectedly combative despite your appearance
findings.explanation: Taiga’s comic classification of Sakura as a martial type becomes raw strength.

findings.highlight: runs straight into the wall
findings.evidenceJa: 柱への衝突
findings.governingReading: a collision with the pillar
findings.explanation: The object Sakura strikes is changed, and intentional straight-line running into it is added.

findings.highlight: Was she that eager to get away?
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に出ようとして柱にぶつかるほど慌ててたのか
findings.governingReading: was she so flustered that she hit a pillar merely trying to enter the hall?
findings.explanation: Sakura’s degree of fluster is replaced by a motive of eagerness to escape.

findings.highlight: Sakura disappears into the hallway
findings.evidenceJa: ふらふらと廊下に消えていく桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura disappears down the hall unsteadily
findings.explanation: The physical instability of Sakura’s departure is omitted.

findings.highlight: As tense as things were getting
findings.evidenceJa: さっきのテンションで居間にいられたら、こっちが恥ずかしくて
findings.governingReading: if she had remained in the sitting room at that pitch, I would have fled from embarrassment
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reaction to the scene’s heightened mood becomes generalized mutual tension.

findings.highlight: you failure of a teacher
findings.evidenceJa: 不良教師
findings.governingReading: delinquent teacher
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stock insult for Taiga’s improper behavior becomes a judgment of professional failure.

findings.highlight: I bet Sakura-chan was even more embarrassed
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を真っ赤にした士郎、いつもより意地っぱりで可愛いし
findings.governingReading: red-faced Shirou is more stubborn and cuter than usual
findings.explanation: Taiga’s teasing appraisal of Shirou, which explains Sakura’s increased embarrassment, is omitted.

findings.highlight: I have to take care of her
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと監督しないとダメ
findings.governingReading: I have to supervise her properly
findings.explanation: Shirou frames his obligation as responsible supervision; the English generalizes it to care.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee sighs
findings.evidenceJa: これみよがしに溜息をつく
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee sighs ostentatiously for me to notice
findings.explanation: The performative teasing quality of Taiga’s sigh disappears.

findings.highlight: This is troubling
findings.evidenceJa: すっごくよろしくない
findings.governingReading: this feels extremely inauspicious
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exaggerated sense that Taiga’s reaction bodes badly is weakened.

findings.highlight: after giving me an order
findings.evidenceJa: 言いたい放題言って
findings.governingReading: after saying everything she pleases
findings.explanation: Taiga’s broader unchecked teasing is narrowed to the final instruction.

findings.highlight: check the furniture
findings.evidenceJa: 客間の備品のチェック
findings.governingReading: check the guest-room supplies and equipment
findings.explanation: The practical inventory is narrowed to furniture.

findings.highlight: a guest room that isn’t normally used
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに使ってもらった部屋とは別の、長年使っていなかった客間
findings.governingReading: a different guest room from Saber’s, one unused for many years
findings.explanation: The comparison with Saber’s room and long disuse are omitted.

findings.highlight: that should be better for her
findings.evidenceJa: 鍵をかけられる部屋の方が安心できる
findings.governingReading: she would feel safer in a room she can lock
findings.explanation: The concrete privacy and security rationale is generalized.

findings.highlight: it’s not like Fuji-nee made me choose this room
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえの言葉に踊らされたワケじゃない
findings.governingReading: it is not as though Taiga’s words manipulated me
findings.explanation: The denied influence on Shirou’s thoughts is narrowed to choosing the room.

findings.highlight: This bed has never been used
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで使われなかったベッド
findings.governingReading: the bed that had not been used until now
findings.explanation: Contextual disuse is made absolute from the bed’s creation.

findings.highlight: Indecent thoughts fill my head
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない邪念が頭によぎった
findings.governingReading: an outrageous impure thought flashes through my mind
findings.explanation: A singular momentary intrusion becomes multiple sustained thoughts.

findings.highlight: It was a good thing
findings.evidenceJa: それを我が事のように喜んで
findings.governingReading: I rejoiced in her growth as though it were my own
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deeply personal happiness at Sakura’s development is reduced to a generic evaluation.

findings.highlight: persuaded myself not to notice it
findings.evidenceJa: 決して意識しないように言い聞かせてきた
findings.governingReading: kept telling myself never to become conscious of it
findings.explanation: The absolute ongoing effort to suppress sexual awareness is weakened.

findings.highlight: she only comes to cook for me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の世話をしてくれるようになった
findings.governingReading: she began taking care of me
findings.explanation: Sakura’s broad care for Shirou is narrowed to cooking.

findings.highlight: I injured my shoulder, he complained about the burn
findings.evidenceJa: バイト先で肩を痛めて、火傷の跡がどうこうという話になって
findings.governingReading: I hurt my shoulder at work, and the subject of my burn scar came up
findings.explanation: The workplace setting is omitted and a nonexistent male complainant is invented.

findings.highlight: She was like a child
findings.evidenceJa: まだ幼さが残っていて
findings.governingReading: she still retained some youthfulness
findings.explanation: Remaining traces of youth are strengthened into childlike identity.

findings.highlight: She waited for me in front of my house one day
findings.evidenceJa: うちの前で俺の帰りをずっと待っていて
findings.governingReading: she waited continuously in front of my house for me to return
findings.explanation: The sustained wait is weakened and an unsupported isolated day is added.

findings.highlight: before she worked up the courage to say
findings.evidenceJa: 一言が出るまで二時間もかかった
findings.governingReading: it took two full hours before she could utter the one sentence
findings.explanation: The observed delay is assigned an inferred internal process of gathering courage.

findings.highlight: Well, she still is
findings.evidenceJa: それは今でも残っている
findings.governingReading: that habit remains even now
findings.explanation: The continuing habit of hiding her face with her hair can be misread as Sakura remaining quiet.

findings.highlight: She always looked depressed and would just absent-mindedly stand there
findings.evidenceJa: いつも暗い目をして、ぼんやりと佇んでいるだけ
findings.governingReading: she always had dark eyes and did nothing but stand there blankly
findings.explanation: Concrete visual description is replaced by diagnostic emotion.

findings.highlight: the girl who only used to look downcast, smile
findings.evidenceJa: 元気のない顔で地面を見つめていた女の子が、楽しそうに笑っている
findings.governingReading: the girl who once stared at the ground with a lifeless face now laughing happily
findings.explanation: The before/after action and the happiness of Sakura’s present laughter are reduced.

findings.highlight: sexy
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体は柔らかそう
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body looks soft
findings.explanation: The mature branch repeats the substitution of explicit sexiness for imagined softness.

findings.highlight: want to touch her
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きしめたい
findings.governingReading: want to embrace her
findings.explanation: The desire to embrace Sakura is again generalized to touching.

findings.highlight: She was always just my underclassman
findings.evidenceJa: つい最近まで、桜は純粋に後輩だった
findings.governingReading: until very recently Sakura had purely been my underclassman
findings.explanation: A recently ended perception is changed into an unbounded lifelong one.

findings.highlight: my mind going crazy
findings.evidenceJa: 胸がおかしくなる
findings.governingReading: my chest feels strange
findings.explanation: A bodily-emotional disturbance is recast as mental instability.

findings.highlight: she has more places to wash
findings.evidenceJa: カラスの行水ってワケにもいかな
findings.governingReading: she cannot exactly take a crow’s bath—a hasty dip—either
findings.explanation: The comic idiom about Shirou’s own very short baths is omitted, leaving the thought incomplete.

findings.highlight: I pour myself some tea and drink it
findings.evidenceJa: じゃーとお茶を淹れて、ざーっと喉に流し込んだ
findings.governingReading: I pour tea with a rush and sluice it down my throat
findings.explanation: The sound, speed, and force of Shirou’s attempt to suppress his thoughts disappear.

findings.highlight: I shake off the image in my head
findings.evidenceJa: 妄想を振り払って
findings.governingReading: I shake off the fantasy
findings.explanation: The explicitly imagined sexual fantasy is generalized to an image.

findings.highlight: She often runs into walls
findings.evidenceJa: 頻繁に壁や柱に体をぶつけています
findings.governingReading: she frequently bumps her body into walls and pillars
findings.explanation: Saber’s observation loses the pillars and adds that Sakura is running.

findings.highlight: She’s clumsy now because she’s tired
findings.evidenceJa: 疲れてるから危なっかしい
findings.governingReading: fatigue is merely making her precarious at present
findings.explanation: A temporary safety concern is mislabeled as clumsiness.

findings.highlight: I believe it was not caused by fatigue
findings.evidenceJa: 先ほどの衝突は疲れからではなく、純粋に目測を誤ったものと感じました
findings.governingReading: I believe the collision came not from fatigue but from a simple error in judging distance
findings.explanation: Saber’s positive alternative diagnosis—misjudged distance—is omitted.

findings.highlight: Even if she’s taking a bath
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に風呂に入っているとしたら
findings.governingReading: if she truly is in the bath
findings.explanation: Shirou’s growing doubt about whether Sakura is actually bathing is weakened.
